text: Microsoft completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard for $69 billion on October 13, 2023 in Redmond, Washington.
Tesla announced the construction of a new Gigafactory in Mexico on March 1, 2023 during an investor event in Austin, Texas.
Samsung invested $17 billion in a new semiconductor plant in Taylor, Texas on November 2, 2022.
Amazon laid off 18,000 employees globally on January 5, 2023 as announced by CEO Andy Jassy in Seattle.
Apple launched the Vision Pro mixed reality headset on February 2, 2024 at its headquarters in Cupertino.
TSMC began construction of its second chip fabrication plant in Kumamoto, Japan on February 24, 2024.
Google parent Alphabet reported record quarterly revenue of $86 billion on October 24, 2023 in Mountain View.
BYD surpassed Tesla in global electric vehicle sales for the first time in Q4 2023 according to reports from Shenzhen.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman was fired by the board of directors on November 17, 2023 in San Francisco.
Intel announced plans to build a $20 billion chip factory in Magdeburg, Germany on June 19, 2023.
SoftBank's Masayoshi Son committed $100 billion to invest in the United States during a meeting with President Trump on December 16, 2024 in New York.
Toyota partnered with Nvidia to develop autonomous driving technology announced on January 7, 2025 at CES in Las Vegas.
LVMH acquired a majority stake in Italian fashion house Valentino for $1.87 billion on December 18, 2024 in Paris.
Hyundai Motor Group announced a $21 billion investment in South Korea for EV and AI development on November 20, 2024 in Seoul.
Boeing delivered the first 787 Dreamliner from its new production line in North Charleston on March 15, 2023.
A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck southern Turkey and northern Syria on February 6, 2023, killing over 50,000 people.
Hurricane Otis made landfall as a Category 5 storm near Acapulco, Mexico on October 25, 2023.
Severe flooding devastated the city of Derna in eastern Libya on September 11, 2023, killing thousands.
Wildfires destroyed the historic town of Lahaina in Maui, Hawaii on August 8, 2023.
A deadly volcanic eruption occurred on Mount Marapi in West Sumatra, Indonesia on December 3, 2023.
Japan issued a tsunami warning after a 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit the Noto Peninsula on January 1, 2024.
Cyclone Freddy became the longest-lasting tropical cyclone on record after crossing Mozambique on March 11, 2023.
The Canadian government declared a state of emergency over unprecedented wildfires across British Columbia on August 18, 2023 in Ottawa.
A massive landslide buried a village in Papua New Guinea on May 24, 2024, with over 2,000 people feared dead.
India's National Disaster Response Force rescued thousands of people from floods in Assam on June 20, 2023.
Greece experienced its worst wildfire season on record with fires burning across the island of Rhodes on July 22, 2023.
The United Nations launched an emergency appeal for $1 billion in aid following the earthquake in Afghanistan on October 15, 2023.
South Korea deployed military helicopters to battle devastating forest fires in Gangwon Province on April 11, 2023.
Brazil declared a climate emergency after record temperatures reached 62.3C heat index in Rio de Janeiro on November 18, 2023.
Australia evacuated thousands of residents from Sydney suburbs due to severe flooding on March 28, 2024.
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced a $10 billion investment in the metaverse division on October 26, 2022 in Menlo Park.
Broadcom completed its $61 billion acquisition of VMware on November 22, 2023 in San Jose.
ASML restricted exports of advanced chipmaking equipment to China under pressure from the United States on January 27, 2023.
Alibaba announced the split of its business into six separate units on March 28, 2023 in Hangzhou.
Tata Motors agreed to build a new EV battery factory in the United Kingdom on July 19, 2023.
Disney CEO Bob Iger fired 7,000 employees as part of a cost-cutting plan on February 8, 2023 in Burbank.
Saudi Aramco reported a record annual profit of $161 billion on March 12, 2023 in Riyadh.
Volkswagen invested $2.3 billion in a joint venture with Chinese EV maker Xpeng on July 26, 2023.
Microsoft invested $10 billion in OpenAI to expand its AI capabilities on January 23, 2023 in Seattle.
Credit Suisse was acquired by UBS in a government-brokered deal on March 19, 2023 in Zurich.
TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew testified before the US Congress about data security concerns on March 23, 2023 in Washington.
Amazon acquired One Medical for $3.9 billion to enter the healthcare market on February 22, 2023 in Seattle.
Stellantis and Samsung SDI announced a $3.2 billion battery plant in Kokomo, Indiana on May 24, 2023.
ARM Holdings raised $4.87 billion in the largest IPO of 2023 on September 14, 2023 in New York.
Sony and Honda launched a joint EV venture called Afeela at CES on January 5, 2023 in Las Vegas.
Tropical Storm Hilary brought record rainfall to Southern California causing widespread flooding on August 20, 2023.
A 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck Morocco near Marrakech killing nearly 3,000 people on September 8, 2023.
Typhoon Doksuri caused devastating floods in Beijing and northern China on August 1, 2023.
New Zealand declared a state of emergency after Cyclone Gabrielle struck the North Island on February 14, 2023.
Italy experienced severe flooding in the Emilia-Romagna region killing 15 people on May 17, 2023.
The Chilean government ordered evacuations after a volcanic eruption at Villarrica on March 30, 2023.
Hurricane Lee became one of the strongest Atlantic hurricanes on record as it approached the Caribbean on September 8, 2023.
Bangladesh deployed the army to assist with rescue operations after monsoon flooding on August 25, 2023 in Dhaka.
South Korea experienced its worst flooding in decades as record rain hit Seoul on April 10, 2023.
Iceland declared a state of emergency after a volcanic eruption near Grindavik on December 18, 2023.
The Philippines evacuated over 100,000 people as Typhoon Mawar approached on May 28, 2023.
Russia experienced severe flooding in the Orenburg region after a dam burst on April 7, 2024.
Kenya Red Cross rescued thousands of people trapped by flash floods in Nairobi on April 24, 2024.
Taiwan deployed military forces to assist with earthquake relief in Hualien after a 7.4 magnitude earthquake on April 3, 2024.
Spain experienced catastrophic flooding in Valencia killing over 200 people on October 29, 2024.
